messages:
laura: Hi team — customer acme-prod reporting a burst of 503s on POST /v1/generate since 11:32 UTC. They saw retries and suspect double billing. I grabbed the request id: req_8f3b2c. Logs show upstream worker restarting around the same time. Can SRE take a look?

mike: Thanks laura. I see repeated container restarts in the runner pool for model rwd-xl-quant at ~11:31:52. `kubectl get pods -n hosted-infer -l pool=runner-rwd-xl-quant` shows 5 restarts. Crash logs include `SIGSEGV` in `attention_kernel.cu` and an OOM before segfault on one node.

alex: Pasted relevant log snippets from the node: `GPU 0: out of memory allocating 512MiB`, then `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'`, then a segfault during kernel launch. Also seeing `nvml: GPU has fallen off the bus` on one host.

tina: Marking as P0 for customer-impacting 503s + billing. Oncall: please attach node id and core dump if available. If it's OOM -> maybe a recent model swap/auto-scale change increased batch size.

oncall-bot: @oncall triggered — pager duty alert sent to alex. Incident channel: https://incident/INC-5432

alex: On it. Collected `dmesg` + container stdout. Kernel OOM lines correlate with the restart times. I triggered a temporary capacity scale-up and set routing to fallback model `rwd-xl-fp16` for acme-prod to reduce memory usage.

jordan: Customer says billing shows 3 charges in a 2-minute window for the same trace. Support ticket: SD-92034. They used a client library with retry=3 and our gateway returned 503s; each retry ended up accepted when a worker recovered. Need to confirm if billing dedupe is working.

mike: Repro notes — I ran a local stress script hitting /v1/generate with max concurrency 60 and large context (8k). After a model swap to a quantized variant we saw higher memory fragmentation; prefetch config `kv_prefetch=true` seems to amplify memory usage.

alex: Repro steps I used on staging: `ab -n 200 -c 40 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -p payload.json https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate`. After ~90s the runner process crashed with same segfault. I captured `gdb` backtrace from the core: `#0 0x7f... attention_kernel+0x...` — points to attention kernel.

tina: Action items: 1) Roll back the recent batchmap/kv_prefetch change on runners for hosted-prod (mike). 2) Open kernel-level repro with ML infra team to bisect attention kernel (alex + eng-ml). 3) Verify billing dedupe for retried requests and patch gateway to return idempotent 409 on accepted-but-not-processed where possible (jordan + billing). 4) Notify customer and issue immediate credit if overbilled (laura).

mike: Rolling rollback now for the autoscaling profile and disabling `kv_prefetch` on the quantized runner pool. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/runner --namespace=hosted-infer KV_PREFETCH=false`. Will monitor.

oncall-bot: Deploy event triggered: rollout/runner  rev: 6f9d5 -> 6fa12.

alex: After rollback the crash rate dropped — only 1 restart in 10m vs 5 restarts earlier. Memory usage stabilized. I’ve uploaded the core + backtrace to the incident folder: `s3://incidents/INC-5432/cores/`.

jordan: Billing team confirmed current system tries to dedupe by `client_request_id` header but the client didn't set it. We should: a) document recommended retry headers, b) backfill credit for acme-prod for the 2 duplicate charges while we push a gateway improvement. Filing billing PR now.

laura: I told the customer we gated the pool, rolled back the change, and will credit them. They asked for ETA on a permanent fix. I proposed kernel/driver investigation + an improved retry guide.

mike: Long-term: eng-ml will instrument attention kernel to fail gracefully on OOM (return 5xx without segfault) and we'll add a circuit-breaker around kv prefetch when memory high.

alex: Opening a JIRA for attention-kernel bisect: RWD-7621. Assigning to eng-ml. Also creating a postmortem template draft.

laura: Customer acknowledges temporary mitigation and appreciated quick response. Setting support ticket to pending-customer for the credit. Closing P0 status once billing patch is deployed.

tina: Good triage. I'll keep this incident open for follow-ups (kernel fix + gateway dedupe).

mike: ✅ Monitoring for 2 hours; will escalate if any regressions.
